svg.title: Mahesh Chopade — Animeplex-cloud bento
svg.desc: Bento grid profile. Mahesh Chopade, web developer making small anime and web projects shipped on GitHub Pages. 13 public repositories and 4 GitHub Pages sites. Languages: php is PHP 69.3% and HTML 30.7%; wheather_report is JavaScript 51.3%, HTML 28.3% and CSS 20.4%. Featured repositories: animeplex.github.io, wheather_report, php and AnimeHub.gihub.io. Find the code at github.com/Animeplex-cloud.
